postTitle: Why does everyone want a sequel now?
commentSubject: @Stratomsk, I appreciate your comments. I wasn't expecting this game to become so popular but I certainly do take it seriously, especially when considering ideas for a sequel. I listen to all comments, suggestions, and feedback. And even if I don't use every idea, I'm still going to try to craft the best game that I can. :)
